title: Shirous Server Pack
description: This is a modpack designed for the Creamy Server for friends to play together.
body: This modpack is designed for the Creamy Server, although if you somehow ended up here, congrats! This modpack adds loads of new features, such as new blocks, winery, farming, lots of Create, Nature's Spirit and many more! This modpack is also aiming to be optimised, so we have included many performance and quality of life mods as possible. All credit for all the mods goes to the mods creators, huge shoutout for making the game fun and engaging. Please report any issues to 0Kio_ on discord.
